name: otp-input
purpose: Entry for one-time passcodes, PINs, MFA codes, and recovery codes: one native <input> holds the code and N aria-hidden visual cells mirror it. Numeric or alphanumeric, paste distribution (spaces and dashes are dropped), autocomplete="one-time-code", overwrite typing, masking, grouping, and a complete event.
whenNotToUse: Free-form identifiers of varying length: use Text Input.
responsive: Cells share the available width (up to 3rem each); 6 cells fit a 320 px viewport. The input font size is at least 16 px so mobile browsers do not zoom.
rtl: Codes are left-to-right in every locale: the input and cells use dir="ltr"; the label and messages follow the page direction.
theme: Cells use the control surface tokens; the active cell uses color-focus-ring; invalid cells use color-error-fg. Forced-colors mode uses CanvasText borders and a Highlight outline for the active cell.
security: Characters are filtered to the allowed set (after NFKC normalization) and rendered with textContent. Events never include the code. mask renders dots and switches the input to type=password. autocomplete=one-time-code enables OS autofill; use off for recovery codes. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: The code lives only in the native input. No persistence, logging, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: 1,000 inputs on one page in the performance test.

limitations: Only ASCII letters and digits are accepted (after NFKC, so full-width digits work).
The active-cell highlight follows the caret on keyup, click, and selection; selection by pointer drag is not mirrored cell by cell.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
unsupported: N separate inputs (deliberately: see the accessibility notes).
antiPatterns: Auto-submitting without letting the user correct a mistyped code (keep a submit button).
Splitting a code into several inputs.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/otp-input: AuiOtpInput directive ([auiOtpInput]) with ControlValueAccessor (string) and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/otp-input: AuiOtpInput component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
